entities.name: Karudis
entities.description: A half-formed demi-plane named by the Archaics of Arcavios; it never developed intelligent life. Professor Kasmina called it "Apex".

entities.name: Ezroi
entities.description: A twin plane to Karudis, a world of luminous, burning, inherently destructive mana.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane formed when Karudis and Ezroi merged.

entities.name: Archaics
entities.description: Beings of Arcavios who named Karudis.

entities.name: The dichotomies
entities.description: Five paired forces formed where opposing mana overlaid the leylines: white-black, blue-red, black-green, red-white and green-blue.

entities.name: Snarl
entities.description: Small regions where each dichotomy's effects are most apparent; the elder dragons were born from them.

entities.name: Elder dragons of Arcavios
entities.description: Five dragons born from the snarls.

events.summary: Karudis begins to develop a destructive twin plane, Ezroi, anchored to the same point in the Multiverse.
events.quote: Karudis began began to develop a sibling, a twin, anchored to to the same point in the Multiverse

events.summary: Karudis and Ezroi fall into each other's reality wells and merge into Arcavios.
events.quote: When the worlds merged into Arcavios, their essences overlapped, but they did not overlap perfectly.

events.summary: Opposing mana overlays on the leylines form the five dichotomies, each with a snarl; the five elder dragons are born from the snarls.
events.quote: The five elder dragons of Arcavios were born from these snarls.

relations.note: Twin plane that grew alongside it and later merged with it
